claims.answer: Vigil supplies root, subManager and worker roles. Managers get spawn/send/kill; sub-managers also report; leaf workers report only. The product executes spawn, send, kill and report as MCP calls and routes results up the manager tree. The app owns the tree, role prompts and delegation tool implementation; the native coding CLI supplies each agent loop. Choose an installed CLI and submit a task in the project launcher. Role configuration is stored in JSON and applies at the next spawn.
